characters.name: KASS KITI
characters.description: Väike valge kass suurte roheliste silmadega, seljas kollane pikkade varrukatega kampsun (yellow long-sleeved sweater), ilma lehvideta. Sõbralik naeratus. Armas multifilmistiil.

characters.name: KOER MUKU
characters.description: Väike pruun koer pikkade pehmete kõrvadega, seljas sinine pikkade varrukatega kampsun (blue long-sleeved sweater). Lõbus ilme. Armas multifilmistiil.

locations.name: Õdus köök
locations.description: Cozy children's kitchen with light blue walls, wooden floor, single square window on back wall showing rainy autumn foliage outside, small wooden table with two chairs, wooden counter. Warm indoor lighting, cheerful and clean atmosphere. Cartoon style.

pages.scene: Inside the cozy kitchen with light blue walls and wooden floor. Kass Kiti, a small white cat in a yellow sweater, and Koer Muku, a small brown dog in a blue sweater, stand side-by-side near the window, looking out together at the autumn rain falling on colorful leaves outside. Peaceful indoor mood. Kass Kiti: small white cat, yellow long-sleeved sweater, no bows. Koer Muku: small brown dog with long soft ears, blue long-sleeved sweater, nothing on his back. The teapot is a round red ceramic teapot with a side handle and a spout. The picture fills the whole frame, no band at the bottom.

Inside the warm kitchen with light blue walls and wooden floor. The picture fills the whole frame, no band at the bottom.

Kass Kiti and Koer Muku stand happily at the wooden kitchen table. Kass Kiti points eagerly to a small bowl filled with bright red berries. Koer Muku holds the red teapot on the wooden table. Kass Kiti carefully drops bright red berries from a small bowl into the open top of the round red teapot on the wooden table (the berries go into the teapot, not into a bowl). Koer Muku watches excitedly next to her. Blue kitchen walls, wooden floor. Kass Kiti: small white cat, yellow long-sleeved sweater, no bows. Koer Muku gently pours fresh clear water from a small glass pitcher into the open top of the round red teapot on the wooden table (the water goes into the teapot, not into a glass). Light warm steam curls upward from the spout of the red teapot sitting on the wooden table. Kass Kiti and Koer Muku lean slightly over the table with closed eyes and big smiles, happily smelling the fruity scent of the warm tea. Light blue walls, cozy kitchen environment. Kass Kiti: small white cat, yellow long-sleeved sweater, no bows. Koer Muku: small brown dog with long soft ears, blue long-sleeved sweater, nothing on his back. Kass Kiti and Koer Muku sit comfortably on chairs at the wooden kitchen table. Each character holds a warm ceramic mug with both paws, taking pleasant sips of warm tea. pages.text: KITI JA MUKU ON VÄGA RÕÕMSAD.
pages.scene: Kass Kiti and Koer Muku sit side-by-side at the wooden kitchen table, waving happily towards the viewer with joy. The mugs and red teapot sit neatly on the table. Rain falls outside the window in the background, but the light blue kitchen inside is bright, warm, and joyful. Kass Kiti: small white cat, yellow long-sleeved sweater, no bows. Koer Muku: small brown dog with long soft ears, blue long-sleeved sweater, nothing on his back. The teapot is a round red ceramic teapot with a side handle and a spout.
